concepts.name: Clean Row
concepts.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE polished high fidelity desktop screenshot concept, landscape 16:9, for the Thai social card game Pok Deng in the existing วงเซียน / MINI GAME CLUB app. Concept 1: CLEAN ROW. Match a premium Midnight Arena design system: near-black navy #080f27, felt navy #102b4c, thin periwinkle borders, bright cyan #26d9ff actions, restrained warm gold #f4ce77 for dealer and winnings, ivory playing cards. No emerald green theme. Crisp realistic implementable web UI, flat screen capture, no browser/device frame, no perspective, no photographic casino scenery. Top header left circular gold playing-card mascot, Thai brand “วงเซียน”, tiny “MINI GAME CLUB”, room “57D03F429” and copy icon. Header right green connection dot, “กติกา”, “โต๊ะ”, outlined “ออกจากห้อง”. Below: “เลือกไพ่ · รอบ 4” left, “6/6 คน” right. A beautiful rounded rectangular table fills the middle, thin double blue rail. Exactly FIVE equal compact bordered player panels form ONE CENTERED ROW across the upper portion, fixed square-ish proportions, subtle avatars, name, chip balance, two small face-down cards. Names “มะลิ”, “ใบชา”, “ข้าวปั้น”, “สายลม”, “ดาว”; first player has GOLD “เจ้ามือ” badge and gold border, others periwinkle. Do not repeat the dealer as an extra player. Center of table: small neat deck stack and compact text “รอคุณเลือกไพ่”, a tasteful three-stage deal / draw / result indicator. No community cards, no poker pot. Below table: full-width bordered console. LEFT 34% is local player panel with avatar, “Gsm · คุณ”, “990 แต้ม”, big ivory 3♥ and 4♣, cyan pill “7 แต้ม”. RIGHT 66% action panel has “ถึงตาคุณ · 16 วินาที” and a short cyan progress bar, two very clear large buttons: filled cyan “จั่วไพ่” with small “รับไพ่เพิ่ม 1 ใบ”, dark outlined “อยู่” with small “ใช้ไพ่เดิม”; modest helper “เลือกไพ่เพื่อสู้กับเจ้ามือ”. Every control visible inside viewport, balanced spacing, good Thai typography and sharp legible cards. Small subtle concept tag “01 / CLEAN ROW” bottom right. This is Pok Deng: no Fold, Raise, Call, Blinds, Hold'em, or five-card board. Don't introduce currencies, payments, advertising or unrelated features. Render the single finished complete UI screenshot, NOT a collage.

concepts.name: Dealer Arena
concepts.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE high fidelity polished desktop UI screenshot, wide landscape 16:9, of Thai Pok Deng in the app วงเซียน / MINI GAME CLUB. Concept 2: DEALER ARENA, visibly different composition from a top player row. Premium Midnight Arena theme: near-black navy #080f27, blue navy felt #102b4c, thin periwinkle rails, cyan action buttons #26d9ff and warm gold #f4ce77 dealer accents, ivory cards, soft restrained shadows, clean Thai labels. Flat implementable web interface, no browser/device frame, no perspective or 3D environment. Header gold circular mascot and Thai “วงเซียน” / tiny “MINI GAME CLUB”, code “57D03F429”, copy icon; right online dot and “กติกา”, “โต๊ะ”, “ออกจากห้อง”. Subheader “เลือกไพ่ · รอบ 4” and “6/6 คน”. Main stage has a rounded softly oval navy table. EXACTLY six players total: one GOLD bordered dealer station centered at TOP showing avatar, “มะลิ · เจ้ามือ”, “1,010 แต้ม”, and two face-down cards; two compact equally sized opponent panels symmetrically on LEFT edge one above another labeled “ใบชา” / “ข้าวปั้น”; two matching panels symmetrically RIGHT edge labeled “สายลม” / “ดาว”. These four panels show avatars, around 1000 points and two small face-down cards. Lower center contains local player hero station “Gsm · คุณ”, “990 แต้ม”, face-up 3♥ and 4♣, clear cyan “7 แต้ม”. No duplicate player panels. Center negative space carefully balanced with small Pok Deng medallion “ป๊อกเด้ง”, “รอคุณเลือกไพ่” and discreet deal/draw/result progress, not a large blank void. Bottom horizontal control strip, local turn label and cyan timer on LEFT, two large equal action buttons CENTER filled cyan “จั่วไพ่” and outlined “อยู่”, RIGHT small summary “เดิมพันรอบนี้ 10 แต้ม”. Elegant modest dealer gold glow and cyan local border guide attention. Small concept label “02 / DEALER ARENA”. Thai card game, strictly no poker community-card row, no POT, Raise, Fold, Call or Blinds, no currency/cash language, no new complex features. Make cards and points legible and all content fit viewport. Single complete screenshot, NOT multiple images or collage.

concepts.name: Focus Table
concepts.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Generate ONE highly polished desktop landscape 16:9 screen for Thai Pok Deng in วงเซียน / MINI GAME CLUB, concept 3: FOCUS TABLE. A modern compact split layout, distinct from ring and full-width top row, but same design system as Midnight Arena Poker: midnight navy #080f27, blue felt #102b4c, periwinkle borders, cyan #26d9ff for player/actions, muted gold #f4ce77 only dealer/rewards, ivory playing cards. Restrained clean product design, excellent Thai typography, screen capture without browser frame, no perspective or photorealistic scenery. Header across entire screen: gold mascot “วงเซียน”, tiny “MINI GAME CLUB”, room “57D03F429”, copy icon; right green online dot, “กติกา”, “โต๊ะ”, “ออกจากห้อง”. Main area split 72% LEFT gameplay and 28% RIGHT opponent list. LEFT large navy rounded table with thin double blue rail. Top of left stage a compact gold framed dealer section with avatar “มะลิ · เจ้ามือ”, 1,010 points and exactly two face-down cards. Middle small centered stage label “ป๊อกเด้ง · รอบ 4”, “เลือกไพ่” with clean deal/draw/result stepper. Bottom of left stage large local card area: avatar “Gsm · คุณ”, “990 แต้ม”, two large ivory cards 3♥ and 4♣, a bold cyan “7 แต้ม” pill. RIGHT sidebar titled “ผู้เล่นในโต๊ะ · 6/6” contains exactly FOUR vertically stacked compact player panels: ใบชา, ข้าวปั้น, สายลม, ดาว, each with avatar, roughly 1000 points, status “รอเลือกไพ่” and two small face-down cards. Exactly six seats total including dealer and self; never duplicate dealer in sidebar. Bottom of LEFT gameplay area is a broad action dock with “ถึงตาคุณ · 16 วินาที” and cyan progress line above two large buttons: cyan “จั่วไพ่” and dark outlined “อยู่”. Small helper “เดิมพันรอบนี้ 10 แต้ม”. Sidebar and main gameplay align neatly to same top/bottom; all fit single viewport. Distinguish local cyan and dealer gold clearly. Small concept label “03 / FOCUS TABLE”. Do NOT add poker pot, communal cards, blinds, raise/call/fold buttons, cash or unrelated features. One final complete UI mockup, not collage.
